title: manuscript-guard supporting passages
description: For a sentence of the manuscript that cites a work, the passage of that work that supports it, verbatim, and where it stands. G7 looks for each passage in the work's stored source under literature/sources/, and the co-author checker shows it beside the sentence. A passage belongs to a sentence by the sentence's words and the citation key, never by a file or a line: a sentence that moves keeps its passage, and one that is reworded leaves it stale.

sentence.description: The citing sentence, as the manuscript writes it. Its citations, its case, its line breaks, typographic marks and a final stop may differ: they are folded before it is matched.

citekey.description: The cited work, by the key the sentence cites it under.

passage.description: The words of the work that support the sentence, copied from its stored source. Words left out are marked [...] or an ellipsis, and each piece is looked for in order.

locator.description: Where in the work, e.g. 'Discussion, p. 7, second paragraph': precise enough for a co-author to find it.

support.description: A person's judgement of whether the passage supports the sentence. An agent may draft a passage; only a person judges it.

judged_by.description: The person who judged it, by name.
